queries: WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) AS avg_transaction_count FROM per_account) SELECT p.account_id, p.avg_transaction_amount, p.transaction_count, 1.0 * p.transaction_count / o.avg_transaction_count AS transaction_count_ratio FROM per_account AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY transaction_count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_transaction_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT 1.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans) / COUNT(*) AS avg_transaction_count FROM account) SELECT p.account_id, p.avg_transaction_amount, p.transaction_count, 1.0 * p.transaction_count / o.avg_transaction_count AS transaction_count_ratio FROM per_account AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY transaction_count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_id, avg_amount, transaction_count, transaction_count * 1.0 / AVG(transaction_count) OVER () AS count_ratio FROM per_account ORDER BY count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
